name: 25-modules
teaches: require, for a guest that cannot open a file. The host walks the node's own directory before the program starts and compiles what it finds, so `require` is a lookup in a table that already exists -- no search path, no filesystem, no capability. A module is any `.dlua` beside the entry; modules see each other; a second require is the same value; and a name that is not there is refused by name, saying where it looked.
